notes.title: PIGFACE Early Access Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes: [p]hello![/p][p]at long last, early access is just around the corner! it’s been a lot of work but i think you guys are really gonna like it. [/p][p]also, i just gotta say, having so many conversations at PAX where people showed their love for the game and their love of games gave me the fuel i needed to finish up the content for this EA release. [/p][p]i can’t express enough how much it means to me that people are eager and willing to chat with devs and share their thoughts and life experiences, it’s amazing. [/p][p]i hope that once this is out you guys will enjoy it a lot and share your experiences so that i can apply that feedback and make the game better and more polished as time goes on. at the end of the day, i’m making a game for you guys. [/p][p]see you in a week![/p][p][/p][p]-tito[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2Ttv1yOlWzs;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Early Access Launch Window Update
notes.notes: [p]We’ve got an update on the development of Pigface. In order to make the game the best it can be, we’re shifting the Early Access release window a little bit. We’ll have more news on specific timing soon. Thanks for your patience![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OOZA4XTFu4c;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: DEMO - Version 0.13
notes.notes: [p]Hey Everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We have a fix for the crashing issue for real this time! Apologies for the delay, it was a weird one to figure out but tito got it![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2][h2][/h2][p][u]Quality of Life[/u][/p][list][*][p]Added number values next to sliders in Options screen[/p][/*][*][p]Modified auto-reload for better consistency[/p][/*][*][p]Modified cancel reload for better consistency[/p][/*][/list][p][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/p][list][*][p]Fixed game crashing after the gamma select screen - [b]For Real This Time[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed push notification UI anchor points for resolution scaling[/p][/*][*][p]Removed bugged laser sight from s357 and tec9[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ability to duplicate drug items by mantling or interacting during their “use” animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the flickering “unfinished” tape in the player apartment[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the ability to scroll through weapons in the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed armour (now it actually works!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed canvas scaling for ultrawide users on the start demo screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the “loud” statistic not displaying properly in the kit screen when toggling the suppressor on and off[/p][/*][/list][p][u]Additions/Adjustments[/u][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted layering of some player HUD elements[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled cellphone when interacting with items in the apartment [/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the shelf at the beginning of the combat test to make speedrunning more interesting[/p][/*][*][p]Restricted the vertical look limit of the player to -70 and +70 degrees from -90 and +90 degrees[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of the table in the farmhouse to combat weird enemy behaviour [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]~ DreadXP and titolovesyou[/i][/p]

notes.title: PIGFACE Demo Release
notes.notes:
[p]Finally, after a whole heap of work, the [b]PIGFACE[/b] demo is ready! Are you excited? I sure am…
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610995/5ae5eeca4dade42ef5a35ab6412784f4f229134c.gif"][/img][/p][p]I’ve tried to polish the hell out of this thing, but honestly I just can’t wait to see clips of people finding all sorts of weird bugs and messing around with the goofy ragdolls. It’ll be for my enjoyment, but it’ll also show me the busted stuff that needs fixing and the cool shit that needs spit-shining.[/p][p][/p][p]Most importantly though, I just can’t want to see everyone having fun. [/p][p][/p][p]I’m pretty confident that this demo will give you guys a very good idea of what my vision is for the full thing. The fact that the gameplay loop is basically finalized means that this demo will give you a good idea of how it will [i]actually feel [/i]to play the full game. 
[/p][p]It’s not just a combat showcase anymore, it’s the [b][i][u]real[/u][/i][/b][i] [/i]thing this time.  [/p][p][/p][p]Anyways what are you doing reading this? [b]Install the damn thing and play it[/b]. Or if you’ve already done that, play it again. And then [u]tell all your friends[/u], I’m sure they are absolutely dying to [b]wishlist this game[/b]...[/p][p]~ Tito
